in_sanskrit.name: रुतुजा
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: One who experiences the joy and contentment of all seasons and climates. The name is derived from the Sanskrit root 'ru' meaning 'season' and 'tuja' meaning 'contentment'.

in_hindi.name: रुतुजा
in_hindi.long_meaning: One who goes with the flow of the seasons. The name is derived from the Hindi words 'ru' meaning 'season' and 'jā' meaning 'goer'.

in_tamil.name: ருதுஜா
in_tamil.long_meaning: One who is born in a good and favorable time. The name is derived from the Tamil word 'rudu' meaning 'good' and 'jā' meaning 'time' or 'born'.

in_telugu.name: రుటుజా
in_telugu.meaning: అయ్యే రూపమై పెద్దదేశము (Beauty/Charm of All Forms)
in_telugu.long_meaning: One who embodies the beauty and charm of all forms. The name is derived from the Telugu words 'ru' meaning 'all' and 'tuja' meaning 'beauty' or 'charm'.

in_marathi.name: Rutuja
in_marathi.long_meaning: Rutuja हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Rutuja is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Rutu' which means season or time. The name is also associated with joy and happiness. In Marathi, Rutuja means 'joyful'.

in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Autumn, Joy
